milestones.title: Deliver RM92,000 in incentives and registration assistance to 111 Kulai students
milestones.description: Teo presented the assistance to outstanding 2025 STPM students in her constituency.
milestones.progress_note: Achieved covers the reported presentation on 23 August. The separate RM1.3 million annual education allocation is not a completion denominator or evidence that all school projects were finished.

milestones.title: Provide assistance to 32 Kampung Separa flood-affected families
milestones.description: Teo’s constituency response provided contributions to the 32 families affected by the 8 May mud flood.
milestones.progress_note: The 25 May report describes a Sunday handover. This records that assistance only; drainage repairs, housing compensation, causal findings and protection from future flooding were not verified.

milestones.title: Implement 524 additional-classroom projects for the 2027 school intake
milestones.description: Ahmad reported 524 projects valued at RM668 million across 459 schools. Three projects were complete and 517 had received acceptance letters at the August snapshot.
milestones.progress_note: Progress is 3 completed projects / 524 projects, rounded to 1%, as reported on 17 August. It is a historical project-count ratio, not a November update, a proportion of classrooms or weighted physical progress. Acceptance letters are not completed buildings. JKR and the Education Ministry share delivery.

methodology: Commitments, documented activities and limited delivery reports are distinct. Evidence-only records have no invented earlier promise. Achieved covers the described handover, programme session or launch only. Shared agency responsibility, historical dates, count units, source limitations and missing follow-up evidence are explicit. No claim of exhaustive research is made.
